name: worker-pool
description: Pool workers the core delegates to. No tools; manifest present to DECLARE config per this convention: WORKER_POOL_SSPACE_HANDOFF (off by default) sends pool_ask from the core to a worker that has its own enabled agent identity as one message in a room both agents are in instead of through deliveries/<worker>/; the worker's threaded reply arrives as a new task. WORKER_POOL_DEFAULT_MODEL (opus) is the --model a Claude worker launches with when its roster row records none (pool_manage.py set-model records one); it is read from this manifest only, never the env, so every start of a worker, recovery included, resolves the same default.
